en: Black‑and‑white view over a historic European town with steeply pitched tiled roofs and a large Gothic-style church dominating the scene. The church has a tall square tower with a spire and cross, attached to a long nave roof. In the foreground to the right is a tree‑lined terrace or promenade on top of a stone wall where a person stands at a railing, overlooking the town. The background shows a wide river plain or valley and distant industrial chimneys. No printed text or caption is visible on the image side.
